question: Should `policy watch --interval-ms` intentionally stop accepting plus-prefixed and zero-padded decimal values that the current parser accepts?
rationale: The documentation does not define canonical textual spelling, so source inspection alone cannot decide whether the existing accepted aliases are accidental coercions or a compatibility contract.

options.title: Preserve accepted spellings
options.body: Keep `+500` and zero-padded decimal values working because they already pass the explicit current parser and are numerically unambiguous.

options.title: Adopt canonical decimals
options.body: Approve the breaking grammar change, document it, and require real registered-CLI proof showing rejected aliases and an accepted decimal control.

recommendation.title: Preserve accepted spellings
recommendation.body: Keep `+500` and zero-padded decimal values working because they already pass the explicit current parser and are numerically unambiguous.
